def get_newly_imported_items(stub_module: Module, source_module: Module
    ) ->List[ImportItem]:
    stub_imports = GatherImportsVisitor().visit(stub_module)
    source_imports = GatherImportsVisitor().visit(source_module)
    
    # Convert source imports to a set for efficient lookup
    source_import_set = set(source_imports)
    
    # Find imports that are in stub but not in source
    newly_imported = []
    for import_item in stub_imports:
        if import_item not in source_import_set:
            newly_imported.append(import_item)
    
    return newly_imported
